Why Element Reno

What it's like working with us

🔨

Real craftsmanship

Work on basements, decks, and full renovations where quality is non-negotiable, not cookie-cutter jobs.

📋

Clear project structure

Every job has a dedicated project manager and a real plan. No chaos, no guessing what's next.

🤝

Respectful culture

We treat our crews the way we treat our clients, with honesty, fair pay, and clear communication.

📈

Room to grow

As Element Reno grows across the Capital Region, so do the opportunities for the people who help build it.

Looking Ahead

Roles we typically hire for

When positions open up, they're usually in one of these areas. If your experience matches, we'd love to hear from you in the meantime.

Carpenters & Framers

Skilled tradespeople for basement framing, deck construction, and finish carpentry.

Project Coordinators

Organized communicators who can manage schedules, clients, and crews simultaneously.

General Labourers

Reliable, hardworking team members looking to learn the trade on real job sites.

Electricians & Plumbers

Licensed trades for rough-in and finish work on basement and renovation projects.
